title: Napoléon AI
tagline: An AI driven version of our Napoléon, we want to create an AI model to evaluate NFT value and then make every NFT can enter to our Stacking pool accomplished our own new NFT model.
description:
we aim to revolutionize the world of NFTs by combining them with the power of Web3 technology. We developed an enhanced version of ERC-3525 SFT with ERC-2535 Diamond. Our platform allows you to check our SFTs and participate in a variety of activities, such as merging and splitting SFTs, DeFi staking…

We intend to leverage this technology within AI-Driven models to assess NFT and allow as many NFTs as possible to enter to our eco-systems and stacking pool for rewards.

An copilot is also featured in this project which used the latest technology like Microsoft AI Service / Open AI in order to assess NFT price and power of our PoS stacking. We could make all NFTs available into the stacking pool.
how_its_made:
We made our own model of ERC-3525 x ERC-2535 model in order to have balance available in our NFT/SFT contract. ERC-2535 made us use bigger contract size file. The merge and split function inside our model to make NFT/SFT have more fun and make people are wanting to trade more.
We used AI libs such like tensorflow, torch and transformers to assess general NTF prices with a preset model. And we use latest tech in AI domain such like Microsoft Azure AI Service / Open AI to make a Copliot version for NFT estimation. That also make every NFT available in our stacking pool.
